report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; traces show healthy downstream calls (inventory, payment, order, postgres, redis) and metrics show zero 502s and p95 ~98ms on /v1/checkout. No fault is established by current evidence; the alert reflects normal latency. Handing off rather than asserting a cause.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency/SLO thresholds to determine whether 63-94ms checkout durations are anomalous
Sustained time-series of checkout latency and error rates over a longer window
Any error logs or non-200 responses correlated with the alert window
